beats.label: The trend
beats.text: Trackers, glucose **sensors,** body scans, supplement **stacks.** All at once.
beats.note: Trend coverage: Gulf News (Oct 27, 2026), Ohio State Wexner Medical Center

beats.label: Myth: more tests, more safety
beats.text: Doctors warn whole-body **scans** often find **harmless** spots that trigger **more** tests.

beats.label: Myth: more pills, more benefit
beats.text: Some supplements can reach **toxic** levels in big **amounts.**

beats.label: Fact: the boring basics
beats.text: **150** active minutes a week, strength **2** days, **7 to 9** hours of sleep.

beats.label: A doctor's rule
beats.text: If a trend costs money or **stress** without a payoff, **stop.**

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: Expert **opinion,** not a new study. Many hacks just aren't **tested** yet.
Follow to keep the basics and **skip** the **noise.**
